channel.title: MITRE Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by MITRE Corporation (mitre).

item.title: CVE-2026-82090 · 9.2 CRITICAL 🌩️ 👻
item.description: Pocket through 8.33.0.0 allows XSS because "Save to Pocket" injects external HTML into the DOM. JavaScript code can alter the application state via native bridge methods.

item.title: CVE-2026-82089 · 8.8 HIGH
item.description: The wallabag (aka fr.gaulupeau.apps.InThePoche) application through 2.6.0 for Android allows XSS because /api/entries data is loaded into a WebView.

item.title: CVE-2026-82081 · 6.4 MEDIUM
item.description: wallabag 2 through 2.6.14 allows SSRF because a crafted title or content field is mishandled during PDF export.

item.title: CVE-2026-38822 · 7.6 HIGH
item.description: In openNDS before 11.0.0, the client_params.sh script, invoked by the openNDS daemon to serve the authenticated client status page, is vulnerable to OS command injection through crafted HTTP GET query parameter keys. An authenticated captive portal u…

item.title: CVE-2026-38821 · 7.1 HIGH
item.description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in openNDS before 11.0.0 that allows an unauthenticated attacker on the captive portal network to crash the openNDS daemon (denial of service) and potentially achieve remote code execution. This is in…

item.title: CVE-2026-38820 · 8.3 HIGH
item.description: openNDS before 11.0.0 is susceptible to unauthenticated OS command execution via shell command injection through the fas query parameter on the /opennds_preauth/ endpoint because of libopennds.sh.

item.title: CVE-2026-38819 · 5.3 MEDIUM
item.description: Multiple memory leaks in openNDS before 11.0.0 allow an unauthenticated attacker on the captive portal network to exhaust all available memory on the device within minutes.
